Amazon Seller Pickup Complaint
Issue: Pickup not attempted despite multiple orders being ready
My orders are ready for pickup, but the delivery partner has not completed the pickup despite repeated follow-ups.
I have been contacting Amazon Seller Support regularly regarding this issue, but no proper resolution has been provided.
I have already filled the required forms and raised complaints from my side. I have also tried to find the pickup centre myself.
Every time I am told that a pickup attempt will be made in the next available slot, but the pickup is still not happening.
I have multiple orders pending for pickup, and this delay is seriously affecting my business and order processing.
Despite these orders being ready, there has been no successful pickup from my location.
I request Amazon to urgently arrange the pickup through the concerned delivery partner instead of giving repeated assurances about the next attempt.
Please investigate why the pickup partner is not attempting the pickup and provide an actual resolution.
This issue has already continued for more than a week. I have done everything possible from my side. Please arrange my pending pickup urgently.
Festive growth is won before peak season. Inventory depth, conversion readiness, and PPC efficiency need alignment early.
